summary: The proof is valid for every stated n, K, and beta. The smallest and singleton cases introduce no exceptions. The prescribed entropy law is uniform on the balanced minimal-face support, and the original-center expansion and common-shift invariance are exact. The convolution argument, positive log-concave coefficientwise minorants, uniform 11/20 surplus, existence of a shift attaining the required integer mean, and Jensen coefficient bound establish the first inequality. The binomial estimate gives the stated absolute constant. The accepted predecessor applies with all side lengths equal to two, and Cauchy-Schwarz transfers its closed-halfspace depth bound to A with the original weights and normalization. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
